name: Lil' Monsta
ability: Each night, Minions choose who babysits Lil' Monsta & "is the Demon". Each night*, a player might die. [+1 Minion]
setup: +1 Minion; no player has the Lil' Monsta character (remove it from the bag and add a Minion). Skip Minion and Demon info.
wakes: All Minions wake together every night, including the first, to choose a babysitter.
interaction: Minions point to a player to babysit Lil' Monsta (the Storyteller decides if they disagree); that player gets Is the Demon and registers as the Demon. Each night except the first the Storyteller may choose a player to die. If the babysitter dies, good wins.
drunk_or_poisoned: Lil' Monsta is not a player and cannot be drunk or poisoned; a drunk or poisoned babysitter is still the Demon.

jinxes.text: If Lil' Monsta & the Poppy Grower are alive, Minions wake one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
If the Magician is alive, the Storyteller chooses which Minion babysits Lil' Monsta.
If Lil' Monsta dies with 5 or more players alive, the Scarlet Woman babysits Lil' Monsta for the rest of the game.
If the Psychopath is babysitting Lil' Monsta, they die when executed.

rulings.text: Minions keep their own abilities while babysitting.
A good player can babysit and stays good; if a dead player babysits, the Demon is dead and good wins.
The Storyteller decides night deaths and never kills the babysitter.
